name: Nyárád (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nyárád: a red shield with a white bird, a green tree and ears of grain, within a yellow frame.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nyárád arms in a yellow frame
